subject: intr
title: (R)INTR.------TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 482 (TRF(II)-18). INTR (interpretation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: AF-NT (affinity nature) and EXPN. From AF-NT: OBS (observation). From OBS: PART (participation). From PART: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From EXPN: INFO-CON (information convergence). From INFO-CON: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From TRS: TR (transformation). From TR: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). From T-C-IMP: RE-ST (restructuralism).
